title: Turning One Protein Down, Not Off

scenes.tts: To learn what a protein does, you lower it or remove it. A knockout alters the D N A. A knockdown lowers how much protein a gene makes and leaves the gene intact. Before double-stranded R N A was understood, worm biologists silenced genes by injecting antisense R N A, with sense R N A as the control. In some experiments, the sense R N A silenced the gene too.
scenes.caption: To learn what a protein does, you lower it or remove it. A knockout alters the DNA. A knockdown lowers how much protein a gene makes and leaves the gene intact. Before double-stranded RNA was understood, worm biologists silenced genes by injecting antisense RNA, with sense RNA as the control. In some experiments, the sense RNA silenced the gene too.

scenes.tts: Fire, Mello and colleagues injected double-stranded R N A into the worm C elegans. It was substantially more effective than either single strand. Only a few molecules were needed per affected cell, which suggested a catalytic or amplifying step. Montgomery, Xu and Fire found no evidence of change in the D N A sequence. Their data supported messenger R N A as the target.

scenes.tts: An enzyme called Dicer cuts double-stranded R N A. Pieces twenty-one and twenty-two nucleotides long were identified as the sequence-specific mediators. We call them small interfering R N A, or S I R N A. A complex called risk holds the S I R N A with Argonaute-family proteins. The S I R N A pairs with matching messenger R N A. In mammalian cells, Argonaute two supplies the cutting. The messenger R N A is cut, and the gene makes less protein.
scenes.caption: An enzyme called Dicer cuts double-stranded RNA. Pieces 21 and 22 nucleotides long were identified as the sequence-specific mediators. We call them small interfering RNA, or siRNA. A complex called RISC holds the siRNA with Argonaute-family proteins. The S I R N A pairs with matching messenger R N A. In mammalian cells, Argonaute2 supplies the cutting. The messenger RNA is cut, and the gene makes less protein.

scenes.tts: In many mammalian cells, long double-stranded R N A sets off broad antiviral responses. So researchers used short synthetic S I R N A duplexes. An S H R N A is a hairpin, usually transcribed inside the cell from an R N A polymerase three promoter. A morpholino binds its target R N A and prevents translation or splicing.

An shRNA is a hairpin, usually transcribed inside the cell from an RNA polymerase III promoter. A morpholino binds its target RNA and prevents translation or splicing.

scenes.tts: Check the knockdown: transcript by quantitative R T P C R, protein by Western analysis. An idealised example: An S I R N A lowers protein X by eighty percent on a blot, and cells migrate more slowly. That is an association. It does not show that X is dispensable or essential.

scenes.tts: Two things mislead. An S I R N A can hit other genes: in HeLa profiling, the most enriched off-target six-nucleotide sequence was complementary to positions two to seven of the guide. And morpholino mistargeting could induce p fifty-three-dependent neural cell death in zebrafish embryos. Three controls catch this. Measure the target protein. Use two non-overlapping reagents against one gene. Rescue with a transgene made resistant by silent changes in the target site. Even a good rescue does not formally exclude a phenotype that also needs an off-target effect.

scenes.tts: The method was the finding. In 1998, Fire, Mello and colleagues showed that double-stranded R N A silences matching genes in C elegans. Fire and Mello shared the 2006 Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine. In 2010, Coste, Patapoutian and colleagues knocked down candidate genes with S I R N A in a mouse cell line and found Piezo one required for mechanically activated current.

scenes.tts: In 2007, Taneyhill, Coles and Bronner-Fraser blocked Snail two translation with morpholinos, and cadherin six B was derepressed within thirty minutes. In 2005, Royle, Bright and Lagnado depleted clathrin by R N A i, and mitosis was prolonged. Clathrin triskelia rescued normal mitosis; the N-terminal domain did not. A knockdown phenotype is an association with reduced protein.
